description.value: Triple O's is a BC-born quick-service burger chain known for its signature Triple 'O' sauce, hand-scooped milkshakes, and fresh-cut Kennebec fries, with roots tracing back to the legendary White Spot brand. The Hope location is co-sited at a Chevron gas station on Old Hope-Princeton Way, a key corridor for cyclists riding between Hope and Princeton. Drive-through, delivery, and take-out options make it a practical calorie stop without requiring a long sit-down break.
